answer_1.quote: ... metaphor ... is a staple concern in various natural language generation (NLG) tasks, including poem writing, paraphrasing, and story generation ... We propose MMTE ... to explore the difficulties inherent in translating metaphorical expressions.
answer_1.outputs: translations of metaphorical and literal sentences

answer_2.quote: ... We introduce several automatic metrics to evaluate the quality of translations, which are described below. BLEU/ROUGE. We use BLEU and ROUGE as part of the automatic evaluation metrics... BERTScore. We use BERTScore as a cross‑lingual translation evaluation metric...

answer_3.quote: ... We also employ GPT-4o as an annotator to score the translation results using the same scoring criteria as human annotators. ... We employ LLMs to annotate metaphor equivalence and attempt to guide the models to provide explanations for their evaluations.

answer_4.quote: ... We hire 18 linguistics majors who are native speakers of the target languages to annotate and post‑edit 647 English‑Chinese and English‑Italian translations, with each sample being annotated by 3 individuals. ... The annotators are asked to judge Fluency, Intelligibility, Fidelity, and Overall on a 5‑point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate translations on Fluency, Intelligibility, Fidelity, Emotion, Equivalence, Authenticity, and Overall using defined Likert scales and categorical tags.
